{{Quote|There's less buzz to your voice these days. Is that a new implant?''"<br />"''Upgraded, yes. The dean of the School of Mathematics insisted. Less buzz means less menacing, or something.|Face Loran and Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
This '''individual ''' served as the dean of the [[School of Mathematics]] at [[Ayceezee Public College]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]].<ref name="MK" /> By 44 ABY,<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the dean insisted that [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Voort saBinring]] upgrade his vocal implant, believing that reducing the buzzing in his voice would make him sound less menacing to students.<ref name="MK" />
